dot.label: Dot size
dot.note: Radius of every dot, against the page’s own. Held between a dot that still prints and one that still stands apart.

density.label: Density
density.note: Dots per character: more carry the same count at a finer grain, fewer leave it open.

spread.label: Spread
spread.note: How wide each cluster is laid around its point.

reach.label: Reach
reach.note: α, how far a message’s departure from the record’s center carries its cluster out: low lays the crossings on a clean path, high scatters them.

focus.label: In focus
focus.note: How many of the newest exchanges are inked in night as in focus: the page breathes between 4 and 7.

seed.label: Record
seed.note: Deals a new simulated record from the same rules. No. 0 is the page’s own.

finish.label: Finish
finish.note: The page’s own three renderings of the ring: engraved line, numbered cells, or a thermal field.

spike.label: Spike reach
spike.note: How far each crossing pushes the contour out: radius = 1 + reach × its distance from the baseline. The page’s own is 4.2; at 1 the ring is nearly round. Read on a log track, so equal travel gives an equal change in the spikes.

cut.label: Inner cut
cut.note: The inner contour, as a share of each crossing’s radius: it follows the spikes, so this sets how wide the cut band is. The page’s own is 64%; below 60% the band reaches the address, above 68% the numbered finish loses its cells at the spike tips.

field.label: Field variation
field.note: The page’s field-variation slider for the thermal field: stirs the color inside the cut contour; the held coordinates stay put.

light.label: Light direction
light.note: The page’s own light for the numbered finish: the depth × light ramp the digits 1–9 are read from.

pitch.label: Line pitch
pitch.note: Spacing of the engraved lines, in the page’s pixels on its 420 px ring. The page’s own is 3.6.

used_in.implementation: A record drawn as a ring of its crossings: each crossing is pushed out from the circle as a spike by how much it changed, the field inside the cut contour is laid in one of three finishes, and the held address sits at the center. tilt.label: View tilt

glow.label: Glow
glow.note: Radius of the glow laid under the newest strands, as a multiple of the page’s own.

adot.label: Dot size
adot.note: Size of the dots, one per counted character, as a multiple of the page’s own.

path.label: Path
path.note: The two filaments and the rungs that join each exchange.

cont.label: Contours
cont.note: The spiral path redrawn at three stepped radii around the record.

curl.label: Curl
curl.note: Radius of the helix the steps climb: smaller winds the flight tighter, larger opens it toward a straight stair.

turn.label: Turn
turn.note: Where on the helix the flight starts: turns the whole stair about its axis.

rise.label: Rise
rise.note: Height of each step against the page’s: held where the flight stays clear of its labels and inside the frame.

tread.label: Tread
tread.note: Depth of each step along the helix, against the page’s: held where the steps still join into one flight.

block.label: Block size
block.note: Size of every step block against the spacing of the flight: held where the blocks neither part into chips nor overlap.

yaw.label: Yaw
yaw.note: Turns every block about its own vertical axis; past ±0.3 neighbors interpenetrate.

pitch.label: Viewing angle
pitch.note: How steeply the blocks are seen from above, against the page’s own view.

sun.label: Sun
sun.note: Size of the sun disc behind the stair; 0 takes it away. Held below the frame top.

pitch.note: Spacing of the dot lattice, in screen pixels, held at any plate size as on the page. The page’s own is 5.

dot.note: Side of each square dot as a share of the lattice pitch; the page’s 1.7 px on its 5 px lattice is 34 %. At rest prints at 0.6 of it, as the page does.

freq.label: Wave number
freq.note: How many crests cross the field. 35 is the page’s ring count; Reaching and At rest scale their waves with it.

cover.label: Coverage
cover.note: A dot prints where the hash falls under (wave + 1) × this. Higher fills the crests in; lower leaves only their peaks.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-deals which lattice points print. 0 is the page’s own hash.

used_in.implementation: A square-dot lattice thresholded by a fixed hash against a wave: dot printed where hash(x, y) < (wave(x, y, t) + 1) · coverage. The wave is the state: sin(35·r) from the center; sin(20·(x + y)) · cos(20·r); or sin(12·x)·sin(6·y)·0.35.

gap.note: How far the plates are drawn apart, as a share of a plate’s length. The page’s own is 72.5% (5.8 of 8 units); below 66% the tallest count block reaches the plate above. The drawing is refit to its frame.

axis.label: Axis angle

po.label: Unlit plates
po.note: How strongly the plates off the current step show. The page’s own is 50%; at 100% every plate is lit alike and the step is marked only by its lime edge.

kw.label: Keyline
kw.note: Weight of the drawing’s object lines (plates, blocks, ticks, recall rings) in the page’s pixels; the plate edges and the lit edge keep their proportion. Leaders and the dimension stay hairline.

fray.label: Bank fray

flowers.label: Flowers

record.label: Riverbed glow
record.note: Share of grains over each strand of the record that print as its glow: green for yours, white for the model’s.

width.label: Width

meander.label: Meander
meander.note: Depth of the river’s long bend.

sun.note: Where the light on the water sits along the current.

light.label: Sun on the water
light.note: Reach and strength of the bloom of light on the water.

current.label: Current
current.note: Count of long current strokes that part round the islands, and of the glints running down the water.

bank.label: Bank line

corner.label: Corner radius
corner.note: How round the cabinet’s corners are, as a share of its height; the mask and tube follow.

prop.note: Cabinet width as a multiple of its height; the tube takes the change, the controls stay put.

antenna.label: Antenna
antenna.note: What stands on top: nothing (the sheet’s), a telescopic whip, or rabbit ears.

used_in.implementation: A rounded rectangle with quadratic corners in the main line; rails, handle, feet and antenna are laid from its edges, so they keep their places as the corner and the width change. The mask and tube corners follow the cabinet’s, concentric, once it outgrows them; the sheet’s is 7 px on a 370 px cabinet (1.9%). Proportion: the tube and its mask take the change in width; the strip of controls keeps its place at the right. Antenna: None is the sheet’s; Whip is a telescopic mast after the CUBE’s, solid where it leaves the set with a phantom extension above, laid lower here; Rabbit ears are two masts from a dome at the center of the top.
used_in.limits: corner radius stops at 14% of the height: the set is fully rounded there, and further the rounding would crowd the controls. Proportion stays where the tube runs between about 1.1 : 1 and 2 : 1 and the strip keeps room for its controls.

used_in.implementation: The mask is a rounded rectangle in fine line; the face is four quadratic edges bowed out by the bulge, with rounded corners. Glass lines sit at the sheet’s fractions of the half-height (0.965, 0.885, 0.77), extended by the same power law (1 − 0.035·k^1.715), each inset to clear the corner.
used_in.limits: bulge stops at 12%: past it the face reads as a cushion, not a tube. Glass lines stop at 5 per edge, before they reach the middle of the face.

grille.note: The speaker grille left of the controls: upright Slots, a Dots checkerboard, or None (the sheet’s).

used_in.implementation: Control sets, in the strip under the tube. Knobs: three pointer knobs and two push buttons, the sheet’s. Dials: two small tuner dials beside the push buttons. Buttons: six push buttons, a tally lamp and a power switch, the PVM’s strip. Dials are a main-line circle with a cap at 0.32 of the radius and twelve ticks; knobs a fine circle with a pointer from 0.35 of the radius; buttons small rounded rectangles; grilles fine slots at 0.6 or a checkerboard of dots.
used_in.limits: each control set uses the sheet’s own parts and spacing, laid in the same place, so none is scaled to squeeze in.

weight.label: Line weight
weight.note: Fine-line width in the sheet’s px (main lines are 1.5 times it); 1 is the sheet’s hairline.

hand.label: Hand
hand.note: How far the drawing wanders from ruled, in the sheet’s px; 0 is ruled.

seed.label: Deal
seed.note: Turns the knobs to new settings and deals a new hand; No. 1 is the sheet’s.

used_in.implementation: Every part is flattened to a polyline, then stroked in one ink with round caps and joins. Hand moves every point of the drawing through one smooth seeded field (two octaves, 70 and 22 px), so lines bow as if drawn freehand while joints stay joined and small circles stay round.
used_in.limits: line weight stops at 0.7 px, where the fine lines would fade into the ground, and at 2 px, where knobs start to fill in. Hand stops at 1 px, past which the set reads as warped rather than drawn.

snr.label: Signal to noise
snr.note: Signal power over noise power, already a logarithm. Lower, and the red noise swamps the wave.

win.label: Window
win.note: How long a stretch of the signal the figure shows.

marks.label: Samples

nogram.note: Measured draws with the whole grammar; Plain keeps only the flat fills, for comparison. While Plain, the pass switches rest.

fills.label: Fills
fills.note: The flat inks of every shape: green cast, cream paper, brown wood. Off leaves each shape in plain paper.

stacks.label: Stacks
stacks.note: The envelope stack’s edge rules at the measured 4 px pitch, alternating a full and a thin line.

marks.label: Marks
marks.note: The drawn details: dial ticks and needle, the address hand, stamp and postmark, the name-plate rules, the wood grain.

key.label: Key
key.note: The measured 1 px keyline around every shape; off, the fills meet edge to edge.

keyw.label: Keyline weight
keyw.note: Width of the key in the drawing’s reference pixels (1000 across). The measured key is 1 px; the thin rules of the stacks and marks stay half of it.

texture.label: Texture
texture.note: Per-ink grain at each ink’s measured strength, fine and unrepeated; the keylines stay clean.

used_in.implementation: A scale, an envelope and a stamp drawn in flat color from measured proportions. Drawn by the source page’s own code; each dial sets one of the page’s own controls or one of the numbers its drawing is built from.

cell.label: Cell
cell.note: Side of one screen cell, in screen pixels. Held at this size at any plate size, so a larger plate prints more dots, not bigger ones.

dot.label: Dot
dot.note: Side of one dot, in screen pixels. Dots print as whole pixels; a fractional size is kept by thinning the count, so tone does not jump. Below 1.5 every dot is one pixel and the screen thins to dust.

perCell.label: Dots per cell
perCell.note: Most dots one cell can hold. Tone is the count: density times this, the remainder kept by the hash.

jitter.label: Scatter
jitter.note: Where a dot may land in its cell. 1 is anywhere (the stochastic screen); 0 stacks every dot on the cell center, an ordered screen.

seed.label: Seed
seed.note: Re-rolls every hash: which dots are kept and where they land.

used_in.implementation: Each cell of a jittered grid prints up to N dots at hashed positions and keeps the last one with probability equal to the remainder, so density is carried by the count of marks and nothing is blended.

gamma.label: Ramp curve
gamma.note: First figure: density = floor + (top - floor) · x^curve across the width.

gamma2.label: Split ramp curve
gamma2.note: Second figure: the same ramp, printed dark green over teal.

split.label: Split
split.note: Where the second figure turns from dark green to teal, with a hairline on the seam.

used_in.implementation: density = floor + (top - floor) · (x / W)^curve, screened by the counted screen; the split ramp prints the top in dark green and the bottom in teal.

pitchA.label: Ring pitch, you
pitchA.note: Spacing of the rings around your source, in figure units.

pitchB.label: Ring pitch, Mir
pitchB.note: Spacing of the rings around Mir’s source. Close to the first, the beat between them opens into wide lozenges.

gain.label: Gain
gain.note: Density at a shared crest: (0.02 + gain · (A·B)^1.25) under the falloff.

reach.label: Reach
reach.note: Width of the falloff that fades the rings toward the edges, as a share of the figure width.

used_in.implementation: Two ring screens A = ½ + ½cos(2π dA / pA) and B likewise; their product, under a gaussian falloff, is the density; the cell takes dark green where A leads and teal where B does.

tone.label: Tone
tone.note: Each letter prints its digit (1 to 9, from its place in the alphabet) as density digit/9 times this.

inset.label: Inset
inset.note: Margin of white inside each cell, in figure units.

used_in.implementation: The words are spelled one letter per cell; each letter maps to a digit 1 to 9 and the cell prints that count as its tone, in the ink of its channel.
